title: AppendError not in UsenetIpfsError hierarchy
description: group_log/append.rs defines AppendError as a standalone enum that is never integrated into the top-level UsenetIpfsError. Callers must handle two separate error types when appending to the group log, breaking the unified error story.\n\nFix: add AppendError as a variant of StorageError (or a top-level variant of UsenetIpfsError) with a From impl so ? propagation works uniformly.
